goal: Dart review: null safety, async errors, platform channels and secure storage.
use: Dart review: null safety, async errors, platform channels and secure storage. Use when asked to review a Dart or Flutter project or module.

steps.note: Read the project setup. Pubspec file, the SDK constraint and the analyser options.
Check null safety. Flag bang operators on values that can be null.
Check async. Flag futures that are not awaited or whose errors are dropped.
Check channels. Flag platform channel data that is not validated.
Report. Each finding with file and line, severity and the fix.
